# hivelocity_services (Data Source)

Finds one of your account services by filtering the service list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_services" "web" {
  status_filter = "active"
  filter {
    name   = "ip_address"
    values = ["66.165.231.122"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.
- `status_filter` (String) Only list services with this status: all, active, deactivated, pending, suspended or cancelled. Defaults to `all`.
- `type_code_filter` (String) Only list services of this type code (see `hivelocity_service_types`).

### Read-Only

- `auto_bill` (Boolean) True when the service is billed automatically.
- `billed_price` (Number) Billed price.
- `contract_term` (Number) Contract term in months.
- `end_date` (Number) End date as a Unix timestamp.
- `facility_name` (String) Facility of the service.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) Primary IP address, if any.
- `order_id` (Number) Order the service was created from.
- `period` (String) Billing period.
- `product_id` (Number) Product ID of the service.
- `product_name` (String) Product name of the service.
- `renew_date` (Number) Next renewal date as a Unix timestamp.
- `service_cost` (Number) Cost of the service.
- `service_id` (Number) Unique ID of the service.
- `service_name` (String) Name of the service.
- `service_type` (String) Type of the service.
- `start_date` (Number) Start date as a Unix timestamp.
- `status` (String) Status of the service.
- `type_code` (String) Service type code (see `hivelocity_service_types`).

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
